title: **Keep the native clipboard request registered until the Herdr operation completes.** `completeRuntimeClipboardRequest(requestID)` removes the request before `pasteIntoMirror` suspends. If teardown runs during the `await`, its invalidation handler finds no request to complete, frees the surface, and the task later passes the captured `surface` pointer to `ghostty_surface_complete_clipboard_request`. Revalidate the live surface identity and pointer before completion, and let teardown or the task claim the single native completion.
body:
Fixed in the latest push onto this PR head (`cursor/nested-topology-herdr-v1-becf`, including CR3 follow-up `7ee2084` and round-4 `93182ba`).

Addressed: **Keep the native clipboard request registered until the Herdr operation completes.** `completeRuntimeClipboardRequest(requestID)` removes the request before `pasteIntoMirror` suspends. If teardown runs during the `await`, its invalidation handler finds no request to complete, frees the surface, and the task later passes the captured `surface` pointer to `ghostty_surface_complete_clipboard_request`. Revalidate the live surface identity and pointer before completion, and let teardown or the task claim the single native completion.
